about:
# CursorOutline

A small WoW addon that sticks a marker on your mouse cursor so you can actually find it during busy fights.

Works on Retail and all current Classic versions.

## Features

- Use a raid marker (Star, Skull, X, ...) or a class/spec icon as the cursor marker.
- Recolor icons and shapes with a color picker.
- Show it only in combat, or all the time.
- Optional global cooldown sweep: the marker flashes and refills clockwise while the GCD runs.
- On Retail, settings are saved per spec, and the icon switches when you change spec.
- Doesn't touch actual raid targets, so it won't conflict with DBM, BigWigs, MRT, etc.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/co` | Show help |
| `/co config` | Open settings |
| `/co combat on/off` | `on`: always show the marker, `off`: only in combat |
| `/co scale <0.5-3.0>` | Change marker size |
| `/co whatsnew` | Show what changed in recent versions |

## Custom textures

1. Convert your image to a TGA with the Python script in `Tools/` (see `Tools/INSTRUCTIONS.md`).
2. Put the file in `Textures/Custom/`.
3. Restart the game (a `/reload` won't pick up new files).
4. In settings, pick "[!] Custom File" as the shape and type the filename.

## Download

[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/cursoroutline)

Bugs and suggestions: open an issue on GitHub.

## Credits

Icons by [Game-Icons.net](https://game-icons.net/).

## [v2.0.0](https://github.com/PeterNumerasz/CursorOutline/tree/v2.0.0) (2026-10-11)

- Merge pull request #13 from PeterNumerasz/feature/whats-new  
    What's new window (into main)  
- Merge pull request #11 from PeterNumerasz/feature/gcd-tracker  
    GCD sweep, Ace3 update, official clients only  
- Add "What's new" window shown after feature updates  
    - WhatsNew.lua: CHANGELOG (newest first) shown in an AceGUI window once per  
      update. Feature releases (popup = true) open the window, deferred until  
      out of combat; bug-fix releases and opted-out users get a chat line.  
    - Fresh installs see nothing; upgrades from pre-2.0 versions see all entries.  
    - Last seen version and opt-out are stored account-wide in db.global.  
    - /co whatsnew reopens the window.  
    - 2.0.0 changelog entry; README command row; CLAUDE.md release step.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- v2.0.0: Global cooldown sweep, Ace3 update, official clients only  
    - Add optional GCD sweep (GCD.lua): a Cooldown frame using the marker's own  
      texture as swipe, so it follows the icon shape. Tinted custom icons flash  
      white and refill with their color; raid markers get a dark sweep.  
      Classic Era reports nothing for spell 61304, so fall back to the last  
      cast spell's cooldown when it is a GCD (<= 1.5s).  
    - Update embedded Ace3 to WoWUIDev/Ace3 master (40f4cc1). Fixes Midnight  
      errors when opening settings (numeric category IDs) and in checkboxes  
      (SetDesaturation removed).  
    - Target official clients only: trim the Interface list and drop legacy  
      fallbacks (InterfaceOptions panel, pre-C\_Spell APIs, manual table copy).  
    - Add an addon list icon (Textures/Icon.tga, source in Tools/Icon).  
    - README: GCD feature line, supported versions.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

## [v.1.4.0](https://github.com/PeterNumerasz/CursorOutline/tree/v.1.4.0) (2026-01-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/PeterNumerasz/CursorOutline/compare/v1.3.1...v.1.4.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/PeterNumerasz/CursorOutline/releases)

- Merge pull request #9 from PeterNumerasz/fixing\_issues\_for\_earlier\_wow\_version\_incompatibilities  
    Fixed an issue where earlier wow version that not supported specializations caused the addon to crash.  
    Now it detects if the current version the addon is running on is capable of specialization detection or not.  
    If it can handle specs, we can offer full utility to the spec-based icons  
    Otherwise we let the player use the custom icons, but it can only be saved to the global profile  
- Added back removed comment  
    Added back an accidently removed but useful little comment  
- minor adjustments in descriptions/comments  
    Minor reframing of the description and comments  
- v1.4.0: Universal Compatibility (Retail, Classic, & Legacy)  
    This release makes the addon fully compatible with all WoW versions, from Vanilla (1.12) to The War Within (11.0+).  
    Feature Detection:  
    - Implemented intelligent API checking. The addon now detects if the game client supports Specializations.  
    - **Modern Clients (Retail/Cata+):** "Spec Profiles" are enabled. Cursor settings save per-spec and icons auto-switch.  
    - **Legacy Clients (Vanilla/Era/MoP):** Automatically falls back to "Global Mode". "Spec Profile" options are hidden to prevent confusion and crashes.  
    UI Updates:  
    - Updated Config UI to display "Legacy Mode" text when on older clients.  
    - Hidden "Enable Spec Profiles" toggle on clients that lack support.  
    Structure:  
    - Added disclaimer to README regarding legacy client limitations.
